caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden object, prominently colored in shades of brown and green, depicting the upper half of a man's head with exaggerated facial features, including a prominent hooked nose, furrowed brow, and tightly closed eyes. From the mouth extends a long, curved red tongue that stretches downward along the length of the object, blending into the carved shaft. The object is placed vertically in the center of the image and is encased within a light rectangular border. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of the same object, showing its proportions and overall form. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color. There is some handwritten text at the bottom right, providing possible identification or credit.
title: Paper Knife
